EmoteWheel source publication

Original EmotesOfTheKingdom project author: Nintending (from wiixlaunch.json).
EmoteWheel runtime changes include configuration, audio, input, HUD and persistence.
The mod/WiiXLaunch source is provided under the existing GPL-3.0 license in LICENSE.

WiiXLaunch: https://github.com/BladesawStudios/WiiXLaunch
  include/, generated/include/, source/wiixlaunch/: GPL-3.0.
  Original WiiXLaunch README retained in licenses/WiiXLaunch-README.md.

exlaunch: https://github.com/shadowninja108/exlaunch
  Other source/, misc/, Makefile and build framework: original GPL-2.0 terms,
  except files carrying their own licenses. See source/LICENSE and misc/LICENSE.
  This is the local framework snapshot used to build the distributed module.

oss-rtld: https://github.com/Thog/oss-rtld
  source/rtld/: ISC; original notice in source/rtld/LICENSE.txt.

Other embedded notices, including Atmosphere, libnx and the nx64 hook implementation,
are retained in their source files. They are not relicensed by the top-level LICENSE.

Compatibility note: some bundled exlaunch/Atmosphere files explicitly specify
GPL version 2 without an "or later" option, while WiiXLaunch specifies GPL-3.0.
These versions are not automatically compatible for a linked combined binary.
Publishing this source preserves the existing grants; it does not establish an
exception, relicense dependencies, or resolve the combined-binary licensing issue.
Clarification/permission from the relevant rights holders or compatible replacements
is needed before describing the entire binary as GPL-3.0 compliant.

No Nintendo game assets, full game executables, animations or music are included.
The code license does not grant rights to separately distributed third-party assets.
